notes.title: Truck Mechanic Playtest is Live!
notes.notes: [p][b]We're excited to announce that the playtest for Truck Mechanic has started![/b][/p][p]Some time ago, we opened the playtest participation form and received numerous applications — thank you all for your interest and support! In the meantime, we've been hard at work improving the game: polishing existing mechanics, enhancing various aspects, plus constantly adding new content and exciting features. We truly hope you'll enjoy the experience![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/995680"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40733077/9ec8151f3b38e8704f86d28ea7ea7b5548cbf1b5.png"][/img] Many of those who applied have already been granted access — check your notifications, as you might be eligible to try the game right now![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40733077/9ec8151f3b38e8704f86d28ea7ea7b5548cbf1b5.png"][/img] Everyone who gets access to the playtest will also see a “Grant Playtest Access to a Friend” button in their library. Don’t forget to share it with someone who’d love to join too![/p][p]We'll continue granting access gradually, in waves, so keep an eye on your Steam notifications to see if you've been selected.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40733077/39264ff82d0c15f3838cdb30cca75b9f7c37f451.png"][/img] During the playtest, you'll be able to explore the entire first map (Jungle) with all its locations and points of interest. However, the main storyline and a number of side quests will be limited to avoid major spoilers. Go wherever you like, tinker with repairs, discover peculiar locales, and maybe even stumble upon a few surprises. And once you're done exploring, exit the map and head back to the garage to try out the novel truck customization options that you've unlocked![/p][p]We're extremely grateful to everyone joining the playtest — especially those who take a moment to share their feedback using [url="https://forms.gle/DQjvcfGD9NDY3DUT9"]this survey[/url] (you can also find a button linking to it in-game).[/p][p]Your thoughts and impressions are incredibly valuable and will help us better the game and smooth out any rough edges before the full release. The project's already in the final stretch leading up to the launch, but we'd love to hear from you and find out if there's anything else we can improve to make the adventure as fun and comfortable as possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ed9e0d82f19ee8ec80f59cf2fc3c7e70564bad3b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]JOIN OUR COMMUNITY[/b][/p][p]We also invite you to join our [url="https://discord.gg/GEV2MrdMzy"]Discord community[/url], where you can actively share feedback, chat with other players awaiting the release, and ask any questions you might have. We'd be happy to see you there![/p][p]Thank you and happy testing![/p]

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary 98
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/b][/h1][p]
We’re back on the road with another exciting post for Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths! This time, we’re focusing on polishing the experience and adding some cool new features to keep your engines – and your brains – running. From reworked minigames to graphics upgrades, here’s what’s new in the garage:[/p][p][/p]
[previewyoutube="2WU7JHkscv8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]
[b] Reworked Minigames [/b]
We’ve given our minigames a fresh coat of paint! Not only do they look better, but they also come with more engaging mechanics.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/a6052944ad54b091827a69f7079dca287aaa152e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]
[b] Reputation missions [/b]
Whether you’re fixing road signs, reviving broken generators, or completing new cargo missions – these aren’t just fun diversions. They’re now tightly tied into the reputation system! That’s right – by completing these interactive challenges, you’ll earn valuable reputation points, helping you unlock new missions and progress further into the world. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/084408164849bf4784d42ba6eb8878aec561a487.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]
[b] Updated Map System [/b]
Getting lost in the wilderness is half the fun… until you're trying to find that one side quest or hidden skill book. That’s why we’ve improved the map functionality. You can now easily track tasks related to reputation, and collectibles. Whether you're hunting down that elusive skill book or just trying to boost your rep, the new map UI will guide your way.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/9d553afb65dac0072ec517afd7eaffdc45eed2f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png"][/img]

Full support for RTX features, DLSS, and even DLSS Frame Generation are in the game for those of you sporting the latest Nvidia GPUs. Expect better performance, cool lighting, and smoother frame rates. But that's not all — we’ve taken the time to painstakingly refine our maps and world design, ensuring every environment feels lived-in, scenic, and worth exploring. From sweeping mountain vistas to gritty back road details, the world of Dangerous Paths has never looked better. We honestly can’t wait for you to get behind the wheel and see it for yourself.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths — Dev Diary 97
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/b][/h1]

It's been a while since we last got in touch, but now we're back with a massive update for Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths, and trust us – it's been worth the wait! We've packed in a ton of new features, interactions, and systems to keep you busy on the perilous roads... Let's dive right in!

[previewyoutube=phI9LPvF1gY;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]New Interactions[/b]

We've significantly expanded the range of uses and interactions for your tools. You can now open and repair gates and signs, or even demolish blockades using your trusty machete. You can also pick up new objects such as cash, skill books that grant free skill unlocks, and customization items. Additionally, the bolt cutters are now useful for slicing through certain fences, while the winch can be used to break down terrain obstacles. And that's not all – keep an eye out for paint buckets scattered around in-game locales to alter your truck's color scheme and give it a fresh new look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ce1dd50ad883d88f2b69907d44f0e6fb25c62c6b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] New Reputation System [/b]

With so many new interactions, we've also revamped the reputation system. To progress through certain missions, you'll now need to attain specific reputation levels. And how do you do that? By completing side quests, cargo deliveries, and smaller tasks that earn you reputation points. It's time to step up and prove your worth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/f110099cf8d0fd40e42dd3f3fc50a4135fc3a15d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b] Skill System [/b]

Finally, the long-awaited skill system is here! We've introduced 4 distinct skill categories: Driving, Mechanics, Exploration, and Economy. Each skill can be purchased with the cash you've collected or, as mentioned earlier, by finding special skill books hidden throughout the world. Unlock them to gain a strategic edge and further tailor your playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/16d9af3a8504fe235c5804270d98d353c9cdbf0f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/eb41efb7b4d3c226ae85bda7a8f35f2d4991b94c.png[/img]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]

In addition to these major inclusions, we've revised the tutorial system to make it clearer and more informative, ensuring that every newcomer knows the ropes. We've also introduced a guidebook where you can revisit essential mechanics or view gameplay tips at any time. Not to mention, the game now has full controller support, updated UI, and numerous other quality-of-life improvements to make your journey smoother than ever before.

[b]Reputation System [/b]

Let’s start with something cool—the Reputation System. The more you contribute to the world through missions and challenges, the more of its doors will open for you. Higher reputation doesn’t just earn you respect but comes with tangible benefits. Think better deals on essentials like fuel, exclusive customization options to make your truck truly stand out, and access to additional quests packed with unique opportunities. Reputation is tied to individual maps, meaning that your standing in one region won’t automatically carry over to another—just like in real life, you’ll need to prove yourself wherever you go. This system is designed to reward exploration and dedication, so keep pushing those boundaries to reap the rewards!

notes.title: Let's talk about save feature in the Prologue
notes.notes:
Hello Community!

Today we would like to discuss the topic of game saves in the Prologue. Many of you are reporting to us that the lack of saves in the prologue is a big problem. We want to explain why they are not there.  First, because we estimated that the time needed to pass the prologue is quite short, and there is no need to add that feature to the Prologue. 

Our game is very complex, we have several thousand parts and their condition changes as well as quite a few changes to the map. Creating a save system in such an extensive game is difficult. Optimizing to make everything work the way we want it to take a lot of time. And we always have to be 101% sure that what we're doing will work correctly and the way we intended.

We are a very small team, and we have to carefully balance our resources. Therefore, we preferred to focus on showing more features than adding saves. [b]Game saves will be available in the full version of the game.[/b] Our Prologue is completely free, and its purpose is to showcase key features from the full version. 

[b]Please remember Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths is first and foremost a mechanic simulator with rough terrain driving elements, not the other way around. That's why you will encounter many repair tasks in the game.[/b]

If you want to talk with us about your ideas, problems we encourage you to join our discord server, where we have ongoing discussions on topics related to our games. We listen to our players because we care about our games being good and meeting your and our expectations.

Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue is a glimpse into the universe of an upcoming simulation game, showcasing the basic mechanics and a story introduction to the full game.

[b]Interesting storyline[/b]
– When creating Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue, our goal was not only to develop a solid gameplay with interesting game mechanics, but also an engaging story. Therefore, in addition to tinkering with the truck, you will learn what dangers you may encounter in the wilderness.

[b]Perform minor truck repairs on the road[/b]
– Imagine a situation where your car has broken down. Normally you call for roadside assistance and the problem is solved. But what if your truck broke down in the middle of nowhere? We give you the chance to test yourself in such a scenario. With a well-equipped toolbox you should be able to deal with all obstacles. Whether it's a flat tire or a broken engine.

[b]Garage serving as a hub for personalization [/b]
– The garage is a place where you will have the ability to customize the look of your truck to your own preference. Steering wheels, seats, gear knobs, and rims are just waiting to be pimped. The more tasks you complete, the more cash you will have for these sweet upgrades! Ride with swag!

[b]Side missions not only concerning the truck[/b]
– In addition to performing complex truck repairs, there will be those unrelated to the truck. [b]Possibility to drive on the most difficult routes in the world[/b]
– The South American wilderness can be a real pain. Even for the most experienced drivers, so be ready for any scenario. Make thoughtful decisions and remember - there are many paths to your destination.

[h1]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/h1]


We are back with some new information, about [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths [/b] in our next Dev Diary #44. Read on and find out what we have been working on lately. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/3ace160c85abbe1858344e14aaa6cb6265e23a2b.png[/img]

After months of hard work, we managed to finish one of the most important elements of our game- the engine. As we have mentioned many times before, realism and detail were very important to us. In the end, we managed to prepare a whole consisting of hundreds of parts. You'll be able to take everything apart and check it out. We can't wait for you to throw yourself into making various engine repairs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/787960d5fece7521dff2e7cad0ce446335d83a0e.png[/img]

Work on both the prologue and the full version continues. We are constantly improving what we have in the game and adding new elements. The workshop is the biggest priority for now. A place where you will be able to change the appearance of your truck.

As always, we encourage you to actively comment and share your ideas with us. Remember that all the screenshots shown above are from a WIP build, they don’t reflect the final version of the game. 

[b]Add to your Wishlist[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1635550/Truck_Mechanic_Dangerous_Paths__Prologue/

See you next time!

We are back with some new information, about [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths [/b] in our next Dev Diary #41. We are very excited to share even more info about the development status.

There are also new locations where you will be able to test in practice the mechanisms that have been added to the game. Planks for example will help drive through big holes. Pretty cool, huh?

We are constantly working hard on the prologue, to deliver it as soon as possible. By the way, we came to the conclusion that we need to somehow improve all roads. All of this is to make driving over them not as smooth as before, and to make them even more of a threat to the player.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Dev Diary #40
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Truck Mechanics![/h1]


Welcome to the 40th [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths [/b] development post. We are very excited to share even more info about the development status. Today we want to share a handful of information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/cfd1aeb4ab4f7fe815b8db33f14cec25f80bd789.png[/img]

The trailer revealed the mechanics that you will be able to use in the game. We're talking about wooden planks, which appear on the back of our truck. What can they be useful for? They will find many uses, we don't want to give everything away so that you can find the best solution for yourself after all. We can only reveal that if there are any significant bumps on the road, you already have a temporary tool to tackle them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/ccc1e5d6ffb4ed80b9e0a315166beeb02a5ad636.png[/img]

We didn’t stop there! We are working at full speed on the Prologue. Furthermore, we are polishing all the mechanics and eliminating all the encountered problems so that you can experience the game to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/7428483e17d74538fccfbcfb580de66debec6476.png[/img]

We are increasingly considering implementing a photo mode, would you be interested in such functionality? Let us know in the comments.

As always, we encourage you to actively comment and share your feedback with us. Remember that all the screenshots, videos shown above are from a WIP build, they don’t reflect the final version of the game.

notes.title: Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths Dev Diary #39
notes.notes:
Welcome to our next [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths [/b] development post. We are very excited to be back and to share more info about the development status. Check out what we've been working on lately.

[previewyoutube=Q4ZL5RAu2xw;full][/previewyoutube]

Let's start with a big announcement, [b]Truck Mechanic: Dangerous Paths - Prologue[/b] is on its way. On this occasion, we prepared a new gameplay trailer, which you can see above. As you may have guessed, we threw most of the processing power at polishing the Prologue. What will you find in it? An introduction to the main campaign from the full version. You will learn some basic mechanics and get to know a piece of the overall story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35053690/95202f235ae00b277bf8e551ce00881b7df8facc.png[/img]

Once again, we've updated some UI elements and severely tested every aspect of the gameplay to eliminate bugs. Most importantly, we're getting the garage ready, we will share more very soon.
